transcript: We now have confirmation on all of the changes being made to the Broadway play Stranger Things The First Shadow for its release on Netflix. They have been filming the show on Broadway for the past week, and this weekend they invited in some audience members to be a part of the filming process, and those audience members have reported back on the changes that have been made. Now, the biggest changes all involve the cave scene for Season 5. So this is your spoiler warning for both season 5 of stranger Things and the stage show. But in the original play, they mention an incident that happened with Henry that caused the creels to have to move to Hawkins, but we're very vague around the specifics of that incident. However, to better tie it in with Season 5, they've actually added this cave scene into the stage show itself. This is during the scene in the show where Patty is going through Henry Creel's memories and replaces a previous version of the scene where Henry accidentally blinds his neighbor. They do show the entire cave scene as it played out on the show, with Henry accidentally getting shot in the hand, killing the Russian scientist, and opening the briefcase. So much more closely aligned with the backstory that we saw in the TV show. They also changed the age of Henry during this incident, as originally the play specified that he was eight years old, and now they say That he was eleven, meaning the time between the incident and the events of the play is now only three years rather than six. The other major change is that we now have confirmation that indeed Jamie Campbell Bower will be reprising his role as Henry Creel in the pro shot. This is only for the final scene of the play, where we see an older Henry Creel, and the role of young Henry Creel is still played by Louis McCartney, who originated the role both on the West End and on Broadway. I was still remains to be seen if these changes will be made to the Broadway production permanently or if this was only for the Netflix taping. Now, obviously you're not gonna have Jamie Campbell Bower every single night, but the stuff with the cave does feel pretty easy to implement permanently. And now that Season 5 has been out for a little while, it feels like you can add this in without it being a major spoiler.
